html: † מִיץ n.m. squeezing, pressing, wringing (3 times) מִיץ חָלָב יוֹצִיא חֶמְאָה וּמ׳־אַף יוֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמ׳ אַפַּיִם יוֹצִיא רִיב׃ Pr 30:33 the squeezing of milk produceth curd (v. Thomson Land and Book, Centr. Pal. 456 RobBR i, 485; ii, 418), and the squeezing of the nose produceth blood, and (so) the squeezing of anger (i.e. pressure, insistence) produceth strife.
